messages.author: 5900eadecec2d82d
messages.subject: Re: combination?
parts:
Hi CK,

Yes, you can do this quite easily. If you want to estimate density/abundance
in the two months separately, but also try having a pooled detection function
by month you should set up month as the stratum layer, with transects within
stratum. You could then do analyses with detection function pooled across
months, detection function stratified by month, or even month as a factor
covariate in the MCDS engine. Assuming no other problems in the detection
function, etc, then the analysis with the lowest AIC is the one you might
prefer.

I'm sure this has been discussed on the list before -- try searching the
archives for more details if you need them. Otherwise email me (not the list)
and I can explain more (we could then post a summary of our discussion to the
list if that seems useful).

Hope this helps.

- Len
